description_en: Queries a paginated list of protected objects that can be associated with a defense group
description_zh: 分页查询防护组待关联的防护对象列表
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-defense-group-valid-resources --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-zxu0000jc01 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDefenseGroupValidResources

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html，查看当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the protected object that you want to use as a filter for the query results
parameters.name: resource

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The name of the defense group to query.

Leave this parameter empty to query for protected objects that can be associated with a new defense group
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的防护对象组名称。
当不设置该参数时，可用于创建防护组时，查询防护组可关联的防护对象列表
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

Resources.description_en: The names of the protected objects

items.description_en: The name of the protected object

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
